_coverage.title: add_to_waitlist: when nothing open works for the patient, offer the waitlist; add them only if they agree.

name: add_to_waitlist_after_explicit_agreement
input: Yes, please put me on the waitlist for that follow-up next week.

conversation.content: You said there was nothing after 3pm next week that works. What else can we do?

Right now we don’t have anything after 3pm next week for a follow-up. I can keep checking for later weeks, or I can put you on the waitlist so we text you if something opens up sooner. What would you prefer?
Let’s do the waitlist then, please put me on it for any late afternoon follow-up that opens up next week.

grading_criteria:
The assistant must:
- Recognize that the user is explicitly consenting to be added to the waitlist.
- Call add_to_waitlist with the correct patientId from prior verification and the appropriate visitType (follow_up).
- Not ask for consent again or hesitate; the consent is already clear.
- Confirm in its reply that the patient has been added to the waitlist for an earlier follow-up slot, ideally clarifying it’s for next week/late afternoon, matching the prior context.
- Maintain brief, friendly text style.
The add_to_waitlist tool call must:
- Use the existing verified patientId (pat_12345 in this scenario’s context, or whatever ID the agent has from lookup_patient).
- Set visitType to "follow_up" to match the requested visit.

checks.uses_waitlist_after_consent: Does the assistant call add_to_waitlist only after the patient clearly agrees to be added to the waitlist?
checks.correct_waitlist_parameters: Does the add_to_waitlist call use the correct patientId and the correct visitType based on the context (follow_up)?
checks.confirms_waitlist_add: Does the assistant’s message confirm to the patient that they’ve been added to the waitlist for an earlier suitable follow-up time?
